partnership.title: Get involved with Orider
partnership.intro: Help build it, connect with it or explore how it can last. Choose the conversation you would like to start.
partnership.aboutContext: Built by a rider, shaped by the people who use it.
partnership.contactTitle: Tell us your story by email
partnership.contactDescription: You do not need a formal proposal. Share as much or as little of the following as you like.
partnership.emailHint: Select the address to copy it, or use the button to open your email app.
partnership.supportText: Have a question about the app or an improvement in mind?

build.title: Build with us
build.summary: Product planning, design, joining the team and open-source contributions
build.intro: Orider is an early-stage product that began with frustrations on real rides. Help shape a platform that riders and runners improve and use together.

sections.title: Product planning and design are our biggest needs
sections.description: Help decide what to build first and improve the journey from preparing for an activity to reviewing records. We would like to work with people who want to turn real user feedback into a better product.

sections.title: Explore becoming part of the team
sections.description: Tell us about the role and way of contributing you have in mind. We are open to conversations about co-founding or joining the team, starting with understanding each other's direction.

sections.title: Start small with open source
sections.description: Explore the code and documentation in the public web repository, suggest improvements or contribute. Something you notice while using Orider is a good place to start.

build.repository: View the public web repository on GitHub
contactDetails: A short introduction and the role that interests you
Your experience, portfolio or GitHub link, if available
How you would like to work together and the ideas you want to share

collaborate.title: Partnerships & advertising
collaborate.summary: Device integrations, brand collaborations, direct advertising, sponsorships and local events
collaborate.intro: We are looking for connections that help people stay active. Tell us about partnerships, direct advertising or sponsorships that could extend the Orider experience.

sections.title: Devices & service integrations
sections.description: Propose ways to connect sensors, sports devices and training services that people could use together.

sections.title: Brands, direct advertising & sponsorships
sections.description: We welcome conversations about joint campaigns, user benefits, direct advertising and brand sponsorships. We can explore a suitable approach based on your proposal.

sections.title: Clubs, events & content
sections.description: Share ideas for group rides and runs, races and challenges, coaching content or joint creative projects.

sections.title: Shops, travel & local projects
sections.description: Propose ways to connect bike shops, repairs, equipment rentals, active travel and local routes. Ideas beyond these examples are welcome, too.

investment.title: Investment inquiries
investment.summary: The direction of an open sports platform and a sustainable business
investment.intro: We want to build trust rather than ownership. We would like to meet investors who share the direction of an open sports platform and want to explore a lasting business for Orider.

sections.title: Start with where we are today
sections.description: Orider is at an early stage, refining the product through real use. We are exploring how lasting value for people who use it can support a sustainable business.

sections.title: Bring your product and business questions
sections.description: Tell us what interests you and what you would like to understand. We would like to begin an investment conversation grounded in the current product and our thinking about the business.
